description: What does this node depend on? Map a node's outgoing dependencies across code, data, and infrastructure. Returns a bounded traversal (default depth 3, max 10) with distance, edge type, provenance, and confidence; depth=1 shows direct dependencies only.

depth.description: BFS depth (default 3, max 10). depth=1 returns direct dependencies only.

project.description: Project name when the core hosts more than one (set NEAT_PROJECTS=...). Omit to use the default project.

name: get_dependencies
